name: TruePeopleSearch
instructions: Open truepeoplesearch.com/removal. Enter {full_name}, your city and state ({city}, {state}) and {contact_email} as the email address, then solve the CAPTCHAs. If your record is listed, press the button to remove it. OpenOptOut clicks any confirmation link sent to that address. Then press "I've done this".
source: Process per BADBOOL's TruePeopleSearch.com entry (name, city, state and email, then several CAPTCHAs).
notes: TruePeopleSearch.net is a different site with its own opt-out form.
